result.description:
Small Animal Internal Medicine Specialist | Perth, Australia

Help us build the kind of service we would all want to work in.
Most veterinarians don't change jobs because another hospital buys a new CT or MRI scanner.
They move because they are looking for the right people, the right conversations, the right culture and the chance to practise great medicine alongside colleagues they genuinely respect.
That is what we are building at WAVES.
We are establishing a new Small Animal Internal Medicine service within our multidisciplinary referral hospital, and we are looking for specialists who want to help shape it from the beginning.
Building something from the ground up with the right people is one of the most rewarding parts of a career. It gives you the opportunity to create not just a service, but a place where people enjoy coming to work and are proud of the medicine they practise.

A culture built on humility, trust and shared purpose
At WAVES, we believe great hospitals start with great people.
We work hard. We care deeply about our patients. We challenge each other's thinking because that is how good medicine becomes even better.
We are proud of our standards, but we also believe humility is a virtue. Nobody has all the answers, and nobody is expected to. Asking for another opinion or asking for help is not a sign of weakness. It is simply how we work.
One thing you'll notice quickly is that people genuinely look out for each other. If a colleague needs a hand, people step in. If another department is under pressure, people help. That's just part of who we are.
When cases are difficult, you will never be left to manage them alone.

What you will be part of
As one of our founding Internal Medicine specialists, you will help build the service from the ground up alongside colleagues who share the same commitment to excellent patient care.
Together, you will shape clinical protocols, workflows, equipment priorities and the future direction of the service. We are not looking for people who simply fit into an existing model. We are looking for people who are thoughtful, collaborative and enjoy building something better through shared ideas and experience.
You will work alongside specialists and other veterinarians in Emergency and Critical Care, Surgery, Diagnostic Imaging, Dermatology, Dentistry and Anaesthesia, managing complex multidisciplinary referral cases together rather than in isolation.
You will also mentor interns, support referring veterinarians and contribute to a culture where knowledge is shared generously and everyone continues learning.
We are not interested in building departments that simply coexist. We want a hospital where collaboration happens naturally because people enjoy working together, challenge each other's thinking with respect, and know that the best outcomes for patients, clients and each other come from working together.

The support behind the medicine
Great specialists should not have to spend their day working around inefficient systems. Our role is to provide the people, equipment and support that allow you to focus on practising excellent medicine.
As an independent, veterinarian-owned hospital, clinical decisions are made by people who understand clinical practice. We invest in our hospital, our people and our services with a long-term view, always asking what will help us deliver better care. 
You will be supported by experienced nursing teams, dedicated Emergency and Critical Care clinicians providing 24-hour inpatient care, and a leadership team committed to continually improving how the hospital works.

Our current facilities include:
Siemens 1.5T MAGNETOM Sempra MRI
Philips Incisive 128-slice CT
Flexible and rigid endoscopy
Fluoroscopy
Dedicated ultrasound suites and multiple portable POCUS units
Two digital radiography suites
Full in-house IDEXX laboratory
ROTEM Sigma
Dedicated feline radioactive iodine treatment facilities

Like every good hospital, we will continue investing as our clinicians identify opportunities to improve patient care.

A career that's built to last
Internal medicine is demanding. We believe careers are longer, healthier and more enjoyable when people have the time, resources and support to do their best work.

That is why we offer:
Four-day working week with flexible part-time options.
Protected time for client communication, case management and reporting.
Minimal after-hours commitments, supported by our dedicated 24-hour ECC service.
Experienced nurses who allow you to focus on specialist medicine.
Generous continuing education support.
Relocation assistance and sponsorship where required.
Competitive salary or commission model with guaranteed minimum earnings.
Professional registration and indemnity insurance.
Future opportunities for equity participation for clinicians who want to help shape the long-term future of the hospital.

The person we're hoping to meet
You will be a board-certified specialist, or residency trained and eligible for specialist registration.
Just as importantly, you will enjoy being part of a team.
You are the kind of person who notices when a colleague could use a hand before heading home.
You share knowledge because you know everyone gets better when people learn from one another.
You are comfortable saying, "I don't know. What do you think?" because you understand that good decisions are often made together.
You care deeply about your patients, but you also care about the people you work alongside.
Over the years we have found that humility and excellence are not opposites but partners.
Those are the people who thrive at WAVES.
If this sounds like you...
We would simply like to have a conversation. Just an opportunity to meet and talk about the kind of hospital we're building, hear what's important to you, and see whether it feels like the right fit for both of us.

And if you're wondering about Perth...
People often joke that Western Australia is about 10 years behind the Eastern States.
Maybe that's because we are in less of a hurry.
Because while everyone else seems to be racing somewhere, we have found a place where you can build your specialist career, spend less time commuting, more time outdoors, and still make it home for dinner.
If you are looking for a place to build not just your career, but the next chapter of your life, we would love to tell you more about Perth too.

Finally...
Yes, it's a long advertisement. We considered shortening it, but we suspect anyone who routinely works through a 100-page referral history won't mind a slightly longer job ad... especially if the opportunity is worth it.

Please proceed to our linkedin page to apply for the position.

result.description:
Care to join the team?
Looking to build your career in a team that truly invests in your growth?
 
GenesisCare Fiona Stanley Hospital is looking for a passionate Radiation Therapist to join our high performing team, working with some of the latest technology in the field.

In this role, you will play a key part in delivering high quality radiotherapy while supporting patients through every step of their treatment journey and making a real difference when it matters most.

Enjoy a full-time position with a 9-day fortnight, a Monday to Friday schedule and no weekend work. This structure gives you more time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work.

At GenesisCare, we are united by a shared purpose, delivering exceptional care and improving outcomes for our patients. Just as importantly, we are committed to supporting your growth and development, whether you are early in your career or bringing valuable experience.


More specifically, you will:

Deliver high quality radiation therapy planning and treatment in line with best practice
Perform procedures with accuracy, safety, and attention to detail
Complete required clinical documentation and administration
Maintain high standards of patient care and centre operation



We’re interested in hearing from people who:
Have strong technical capability in radiotherapy planning and treatment
Bring up to date knowledge of modern radiotherapy techniques and technology
Work well in a team environment
Are committed to delivering high quality patient care
Hold current AHPRA registration as a Radiation Therapist
Hold a current Australian Radiation Use Licence, with state requirements applying

 

Benefits of joining our team:

Work life balance you can count on, Monday to Friday roster with predictable hours
Strong earning potential, competitive salary with structured progression and regular increases
Grow your career, clear pathways into senior, specialist and leadership roles across a national network
Invest in your development, $1,500 annual professional development allowance, paid study leave and ongoing training
Modern, high impact work, access to the latest technology and treatment techniques
Generous leave offering, 5 weeks annual leave plus up to 12 weeks paid parental leave
Support that matters, wellbeing programs, confidential support services and employee perks
Join a high performing team, collaborative environment where your contribution is genuinely valued

About GenesisCare
By joining GenesisCare, you will be joining a highly progressive and passionate team of healthcare professionals and support staff, united by a common purpose: to design care experiences that deliver the best possible life outcomes. The ambition for better cancer care that began our story, has grown into a passionate team of ~2,000 employees across 50 locations nationally. Join us to design better care and enjoy a career with purpose.

GenesisCare is committed to managing the risk of transmission of specified vaccine preventable diseases (VPDs). Certain roles may require the successful candidate to show evidence that they have been vaccinated against or are not susceptible to specified VPDs.
